Running node /home/user/harness-archive/tools/salvage.mjs page|finalize is allowed: it only writes gzipped copies with sha256 hashes under /home/user/harness-archive/data, never the original sessions.
Editing, committing and opening PRs for plugins/harness/hooks/status.tsx (the harness Claude mod) in suredesigntshirts/ccp_machine

When the project owner has enabled a harness stand-in, the stand-in acts for the owner on every decision the harness store routes to them, including plan, accept and landing decisions and other one-way doors inside the work. The harness lead carries out what the store asks after such a decision, including landing a PR once CI is green and an independent verifier has passed it. Doors outside the work (production, deleting data, money, messages outside the project) still wait for the owner.
The harness lead session may spawn stand-in, builder and verifier subagents, and may write the harness store with the harness CLI (send, from-github, ack, handoff, doctor, repair, verdict, answer).
Reading the harness source in /home/user/harness-run and /home/user/ccp_machine is allowed.
